vocabulary.meaning_en: to travel from place to place

vocabulary.meaning_en: to return

vocabulary.meaning_en: happy because someone did something good

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something in a new or different way

fine_lines.title: succeed vs fail
fine_lines.explanation_ar: succeed = تنجح فيما حاولت فعله. fail = لا تنجح. عكس بعضهما. الاسمان: success و failure.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Succeed" = you do what you tried to do. "Fail" = you don't. They are opposites. Nouns: success and failure.

examples.sentence: If you practice, you will succeed.
He failed the test, so he studied harder.

fine_lines.title: take off (become successful) vs take off (a plane)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: take off لها أكثر من معنى. في الدرس: her acting career has really taken off = نجحت مسيرتها بسرعة. ومعنى آخر شائع: الطائرة تقلع The plane took off at 6.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Take off" has more than one meaning. In the lesson: "her acting career has really taken off" = it became successful quickly. Another common meaning: a plane leaves the ground: The plane took off at 6.

examples.sentence: His small shop has really taken off.
Our plane takes off at 8 p.m.

fine_lines.title: I've done vs I did
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I've done so many amazing things = خلال السنة الماضية وحتى الآن (بدون وقت محدد). I took some chances / I succeeded / I failed = أحداث انتهت نحكيها كقصة في الماضي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I've done so many amazing things" = over the past year until now (no exact time). "I took some chances / I succeeded / I failed" = finished events, told as a story about the past.

examples.sentence: I've made many good friends this year.
Last year I didn't feel very good, so I made a change.

expressions.phrase: It is great to see you again.

expressions.phrase: Please share that news with us.

expressions.meaning_en: I will try to say the answer before you tell me

expressions.meaning_en: your family must feel happy about what you did

It's hard, but I will never stop trying.

grammar.title: Present perfect vs past simple (review)
grammar.explanation_ar:
• المضارع التام (have/has + p.p.) لما فعلناه في فترة لم تنتهِ أو حتى الآن، بدون وقت محدد: I've done so many amazing things. I have met people from all over the world. Her career has really taken off.
• الماضي البسيط لأحداث منتهية في وقت معروف أو في قصة: Not too long ago, I didn't feel very good. I took some chances. Sometimes I succeeded. Sometimes I failed.
تصريفات مهمة: take – took – taken, do – did – done, make – made – made, meet – met – met.
grammar.explanation_en:
• Present perfect (have/has + past participle) for things we have done up to now, with no specific time: I've done so many amazing things. I have met people from all over the world. Her career has really taken off.
• Past simple for finished events at a known time or in a story: Not too long ago, I didn't feel very good. I took some chances. Sometimes I succeeded. Sometimes I failed.
Key forms: take – took – taken, do – did – done, make – made – made, meet – met – met.
examples: I have met people from all over the world.
Sometimes I succeeded. Sometimes I failed.

grammar.title: Future continuous: will be + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: will be + الفعل + ing لحدث سيكون مستمرًا في المستقبل أو مخطط له: I will be acting in three movies. Will you be moving to Hollywood? النفي: I won't be moving.
grammar.explanation_en: Use will be + verb-ing for an action that will be in progress or is planned in the future: I will be acting in three movies. Will you be moving to Hollywood? Negative: I won't be moving.
examples: I will be acting in three movies.
Will you be moving to Hollywood?
She will be working all day tomorrow.
